settings.label: Logo for Google
settings.info: Square logo used in search results and structured data. Use Brand Kit/2-instagram/instagram-profile-1080.png.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Use Brand Kit/1-logo/icon-colour.png.

settings.label: Default share image
settings.info: Shown when a page without its own image is shared on WhatsApp or social media. 1200 × 630 px.

settings.label: Show logo intro
settings.info: Plays the brand kit logo animation (about 3 seconds) on the first page of a visit, at most once a day per visitor. Never on cart, account or search pages. Any tap or scroll skips it.

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: With country code, like +91 98765 43210.

settings.label: "Shop all" collection
settings.info: Where every "Shop all" link goes: the hero, Bestsellers, the menu, the empty cart. Use a collection of everything you sell, without the free gift (for example an automated collection: tag is not equal to free-gift). Left empty, the links go to Shopify's list of all products, which includes the gift.

settings.content: Shown in the search panel before someone types, and on a search with no matches. See docs/search-plan.md.

settings.label: Popular searches menu
settings.info: Create a menu called "Popular searches" in Content → Menus, with 4–6 links to collections or searches.

settings.label: Products to suggest
settings.info: Up to 4 products from this collection. If empty, the "bestsellers" collection is used (or "our-favourites").

settings.content: The cart drawer and cart page. See docs/cart-plan.md.

settings.label: Free shipping from (₹)
settings.info: Shows "Add ₹… more for free shipping" in the cart, and "Free shipping over ₹…" in the announcement bar and on product pages. Leave at 0 to hide it. Set the same amount as a free rate in Settings → Shipping and delivery (docs/offers-plan.md).

settings.label: Standard shipping fee (₹)
settings.info: Optional. Under the free-shipping amount the cart says "Shipping ₹…" instead of "Shipping calculated at checkout". From that amount, the price details strike it through beside "Free" and count it in "You save". Must match your paid rate in Settings → Shipping and delivery.

settings.label: Free gift from (₹)
settings.info: The second goal on the cart's progress bar. Must be higher than the free-shipping amount. Leave at 0 to hide it.

settings.label: Free gift product
settings.info: Give it its real price, track its stock and keep it out of collections. An automatic "Buy X get Y" discount makes it free (docs/offers-plan.md §5.4). The cart adds it once the order reaches the amount above, and the step hides itself when the gift is sold out.

settings.label: Money off, step 1: from (₹)
settings.info: The next goal on the cart's progress bar after the gift, e.g. 999. Must be higher than the amounts above. It only shows the step: the saving itself is an automatic discount with the same minimum in Discounts (docs/pricing-plan.md). Leave at 0 to hide it.

settings.label: Money off, step 1: amount (₹)
settings.info: e.g. 50. Must match the automatic discount.

settings.label: Money off, step 2: from (₹)
settings.info: Optional, higher than step 1, e.g. 1299. The two savings never add up: the larger one replaces the smaller.

settings.label: Money off, step 2: amount (₹)
settings.info: e.g. 100. Must match the automatic discount.

settings.label: Most of one piece per order
settings.info: The quantity stops here on product pages and in the cart, with a line sending larger orders to WhatsApp. Leave at 0 for no limit. Stock still wins when it is lower.

settings.label: Cash on delivery available
settings.info: Says "Cash on delivery" in the announcement bar and on product pages. Only turn it on once COD works at checkout.

settings.label: Show the gift note
settings.info: Saved as the order note, so you see it when packing.

settings.label: Show "Little extras" on the cart page
settings.info: Up to 4 small products from Shopify's product recommendations.

settings.label: Show demo content
settings.info: Fills empty slots with brand illustrations, sample products and sample reviews while the store is being built. Turn this off before launch.
